purpose: Can a conditioned flow memorize a small teacher ensemble, and does independent PCA prevent it?
selection: 32 training-only proteins with mean teacher pLDDT>=0.8, at least max(32,ceil(L/2)) confident residues,2..8 contact states and mean contact-feature distance<=6A. Five length128 and nine each256/384/512, highest mean confidence then ID within bucket. Revised before any student training after extreme-diversity selection failed reconstruction.
state_definition: Shared mean-confidence >=0.7 core; all residues if fewer than max(32,ceil(L/2)); separation>3, teacher distance range>=2A and min<=12A; deterministic lexicographic subsample at most4096 contacts. Connected components at feature RMSD<=1A; only coarse-valid source teachers define states.
evaluation: Fresh flow seeds;32 samples per training protein at0/500/2000; CFG1 and CFG2 both reported. Valid state hit requires featureRMSE<=2A, nearest-contact teacher CA-lDDT>=0.8, coarse-valid geometry. No native filtering of generated samples. This measures teacher-mode recall, not biological-state coverage.
teacher_distribution: Uniform over the same valid teacher conformations, no reference mixture. Reference control draws only bitwise cached labels. Pure-teacher supervision deliberately tests capacity before repeating mixed-data optimization.
batching: Same32/16/8/8 production batches, permutation cycles with independent sample noise;5/9/9/9 unique targets in four buckets
decision: First test training-set valid mode recall versus initialization and reference control. If it improves, test generalization before promotion; otherwise diagnose optimization, conditioning and decoded geometry. All settings retained, no test scoring.
